srList.sentence: Immunohistochemical Analyses Airway smooth muscle (ASM) mass and airway mucus secretion was observed using immunohistochemical staining, based on the presence of alpha-smooth muscle actin (a-SMA) and Muc5ac protein in lung tissue sections with the mouse a-SMA antibody (Proteintech, Wuhan, China) and mouse Muc5ac antibody (GTX11335, GeneTex, USA), as previously described.
